notes.title: Impulse Rogue: Demo, Devs, and Demons!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=kMQ22p7oHNg;full][/previewyoutube]

Are you a seasoned Soulsborne veteran thirsty for a new challenge?

Dive into the world of Impulse Rogue with this action-packed livestream. We'll showcase epic boss battles, breathtaking landscapes filled with hidden dangers, and the unforgiving mechanics that will test your skills. Our developers will be live, ready to answer your questions about character builds, level design, and the lore behind this captivating world. 

Don't miss this chance to be among the first to experience this challenging and rewarding Soulslike adventure!
